mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password, real_name, phone, email, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{role}, #{enabled}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, real_name = #{realName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, role = #{role}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, phone, email, role, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user
